Security Services Committee of the People's Majlis
Agenda

Committee: Security Services Committee of the People's Majlis
Meeting: 08th meeting
Venue: Committee Room 04
Date: 26 October 2026 (Monday)
Time: 10:30

Reviewing issues submitted to the committee:
1. Issue submitted requesting that the relevant officials of the MNDF and the Police be summoned, in order to share concerns about tragic incidents occurring in maritime operations carried out by the security services, and to hold the relevant parties accountable, as it is not known whether any inquiry or investigation has been conducted into those incidents to determine their causes and ensure such incidents do not recur, or whether it has been examined if any party was negligent or failed to fulfil a responsibility.
2. Issue submitted requesting that the heads of the relevant offices be summoned to the committee to look into the matter and take urgent action, regarding the two boats that entered the Maldives in violation of regulations, anchored in Malé, broke loose from their anchors and drifted into the Sinamalé Bridge, as this is an issue showing that the Maldivian maritime area and the maritime area directly related to the safety and security of the Malé region are not being monitored to the extent required.
3. Issue submitted requesting the committee to expedite work on the amendment submitted to the Employment Act, as money collected as service charge is being converted into Maldivian rufiyaa and paid out in rufiyaa.

Bills submitted to the committee:
1. Bill to amend Law No. 32/2025 (Prevention of Terrorism Act), submitted by the Member for North Galolhu constituency, Mohamed Ibrahim

2. Bill to amend Law No. 2/2008 (Employment Act), submitted by the Member for Kendhoo constituency, Mauroof Zakir

Confidential issues:
4. Letter sent by the Maldives Correctional Service on 21 October 2026.
5. Issue submitted by a whistleblower on 10 November 2025 regarding the Maldives Police Service.
6. Issue submitted by a whistleblower on 02 December 2025 regarding the Maldives Police Service.

Letters from members of the public:
1. Letter sent by a member of the public on 06 April 2025 requesting to meet the committee.
2. Letter sent by a member of the public on 03 December 2025 requesting to meet the committee.
